verses.en: Verily I say unto you who have assembled yourselves together that you may learn my will concerning the redemption of mine afflicted people—
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou o e ua faapotopoto faatasi outou lava ina ia outou iloa lo’u loto e faatatau i le laveaiina o lo’u nuu puapuagatia—

verses.en: Behold, I say unto you, were it not for the transgressions of my people, speaking concerning the church and not individuals, they might have been redeemed even now.
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a na leai soligatulafono a lo’u nuu, i le tautala atu lea e faatatau i le ekalesia ae lē o tagata taitoatasi, po ua laveaiina i latou i le taimi nei lava.

verses.en: But behold, they have not learned to be obedient to the things which I required at their hands, but are full of all manner of evil, and do not impart of their substance, as becometh saints, to the poor and afflicted among them;
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ua latou lē aoao e usiusitai i mea na Ou manaomia mai i o latou lima, ae ua tumu i ituaiga o leaga uma, ma ua lē faasoa atu a latou mea, e pei ona tatau ai i se au paia, i e matitiva ma e puapuagatia o i totonu o i latou;

verses.en: And are not united according to the union required by the law of the celestial kingdom;
verses.sm: Ma ua lē lotogatasi e tusa ma le tuufaatasiga ua manaomia e le tulafono o le malo selesitila;

verses.en: And Zion cannot be built up unless it is by the principles of the law of the celestial kingdom; otherwise I cannot receive her unto myself.
verses.sm: Ma e lē mafai ona ati a’e Siona vagana ua ati a’e i mataupu autu o le tulafono o le malo selesitila, a lē o lea e lē mafai ona Ou talia o ia mo a’u.

verses.en: And my people must needs be chastened until they learn obedience, if it must needs be, by the things which they suffer.
verses.sm: Ma e tatau ona aoaiina lo’u nuu, pe afai e tatau ai, e ala i mea latou te mafatia ai, seia latou aoao le usiusitai.

verses.en: I speak not concerning those who are appointed to lead my people, who are the first elders of my church, for they are not all under this condemnation;
verses.sm: Ou te lē o tautala atu e faatatau ia te i latou o e ua tofia e taitaia lo’u nuu, o e o toeaina muamua o la’u ekalesia, aua ua lē i ai i latou uma i lalo o lenei tausalaga;

verses.en: But I speak concerning my churches abroad—there are many who will say: Where is their God? Behold, he will deliver them in time of trouble, otherwise we will not go up unto Zion, and will keep our moneys.
verses.sm: Ae ua Ou tautala atu e faatatau i a’u aulotu salalau— ua i ai le toatele o e o le a fai mai: O fea lo latou Atua? Faauta, o le a laveai e ia i latou i taimi o faalavelave, a lē o lea matou te lē o atu i Siona, ma o le a taofi a matou tupe.

verses.en: Therefore, in consequence of the transgressions of my people, it is expedient in me that mine elders should wait for a little season for the redemption of Zion—
verses.sm: O lea, ona o soligatulafono a lo’u nuu, ua tatau ai ia te a’u ona faatali a’u toeaina mo se vaitau itiiti mo le laveaiina o Siona—

verses.en: That they themselves may be prepared, and that my people may be taught more perfectly, and have experience, and know more perfectly concerning their duty, and the things which I require at their hands.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona saunia i latou lava, ma ia mafai ona aoaoina atili atoatoa lo’u nuu, ma maua le poto masani, ma iloa atili atoatoa e faatatau i lo latou tiute, ma mea ua Ou manaomia mai i o latou lima.

verses.en: And this cannot be brought to pass until mine elders are endowed with power from on high.
verses.sm: Ma e lē mafai ona faataunuuina lenei mea seia faaeeina a’u toeaina i le mana mai luga.

verses.en: For behold, I have prepared a great endowment and blessing to be poured out upon them, inasmuch as they are faithful and continue in humility before me.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, ua Ou saunia se faaeega ma se faamanuiaga tele ia liligi ifo i luga o i latou, e tusa ai ma lo latou faamaoni ma faaauau pea i le lotomaualalo i o’u luma.

verses.en: Therefore it is expedient in me that mine elders should wait for a little season, for the redemption of Zion.
verses.sm: O lea ua ao ai ia te a’u le tatau ona faatali o a’u toeaina mo se vaitau itiiti, mo le laveaiina o Siona.

verses.en: For behold, I do not require at their hands to fight the battles of Zion; for, as I said in a former commandment, even so will I fulfil—I will fight your battles.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, Ou te lē manaomia mai i o latou lima le tau o taua a Siona; aua, e pei ona Ou fai atu i se poloaiga muamua atu, o le a faapea lava ona Ou faataunuuina— o le a Ou tauina a outou taua.

verses.en: Behold, the destroyer I have sent forth to destroy and lay waste mine enemies; and not many years hence they shall not be left to pollute mine heritage, and to blaspheme my name upon the lands which I have consecrated for the gathering together of my saints.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou auina atu lē faaumatia e faatamaia ma faatafuna o’u fili; ma e lē tele ni tausaga mai le taimi nei ae o le a lē tuua i latou e faaeleeleaina lo’u tofi, ma upuleagaina lo’u igoa i luga o laueleele ua Ou faapaiaina mo le faapotopotoina faatasi o la’u au paia.

verses.en: Behold, I have commanded my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., to say unto the strength of my house, even my warriors, my young men, and middle-aged, to gather together for the redemption of my people, and throw down the towers of mine enemies, and scatter their watchmen;
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou poloaiina la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e fai atu i le malosi o lo’u fale, o o’u tagata tau lava, o o’u alii talavou, ma faamatuā tagata, ia faapotopoto faatasi mo le laveaiina o lo’u nuu, ma lafo i lalo olo o o’u fili, ma faataapeape o latou leoleo;

verses.en: But the strength of mine house have not hearkened unto my words.
verses.sm: Ae ua lē faalogo mai le malosi o lo’u fale i a’u upu.

verses.en: But inasmuch as there are those who have hearkened unto my words, I have prepared a blessing and an endowment for them, if they continue faithful.
verses.sm: Ae afai e i ai i latou o e na faalogo i a’u upu, ua Ou saunia se faamanuiaga ma se faaeega mo i latou, pe afai latou te tumau pea i le faamaoni.

verses.en: I have heard their prayers, and will accept their offering; and it is expedient in me that they should be brought thus far for a trial of their faith.
verses.sm: Ua Ou faalogoina a latou tatalo, ma o le a Ou talia la latou taulaga; ma ua tatau ai ia te a’u ona aumai i latou seia oo mai iinei mo se tofotofoga o lo latou faatuatua.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, a commandment I give unto you, that as many as have come up hither, that can stay in the region round about, let them stay;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, o le toatele o i latou ua o mai iinei, e mafai ona nonofo i itulagi faataamilo ai, ia tuu ia te i latou e nonofo;

verses.en: And those that cannot stay, who have families in the east, let them tarry for a little season, inasmuch as my servant Joseph shall appoint unto them;
verses.sm: Ma o i latou e lē mafai ona nonofo, o e o i ai aiga i sasa’e, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e nonofo mo se vaitau itiiti, pe a tofia ai i latou e la’u auauna o Iosefa;

verses.en: For I will counsel him concerning this matter, and all things whatsoever he shall appoint unto them shall be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Aua o le a Ou fautuaina o ia e faatatau i lenei mataupu, ma o mea uma po o le a lava o le a ia tofia ai i latou o le a faataunuuina lava.

verses.en: And let all my people who dwell in the regions round about be very faithful, and prayerful, and humble before me, and reveal not the things which I have revealed unto them, until it is wisdom in me that they should be revealed.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i o’u tagata uma o e o nonofo i nofoaga o faataamilo ai ina ia matua faamaoni, ma tatalo, ma faamaualalo i o’u luma, ma lē faaali atu mea ua Ou faaali atu ia te i latou, seia poto ia te a’u le tatau ona faaali atu o ia mea.

verses.en: Talk not of judgments, neither boast of faith nor of mighty works, but carefully gather together, as much in one region as can be, consistently with the feelings of the people;
verses.sm: Aua le tautala e uiga i faamasinoga, pe mitamita i le faatuatua po o galuega tetele, ae ia faapotopoto faatasi ma le faaeteete, i se itulagi e tasi pe a mafai, e tusa ai ma lagona o tagata;

verses.en: And behold, I will give unto you favor and grace in their eyes, that you may rest in peace and safety, while you are saying unto the people: Execute judgment and justice for us according to law, and redress us of our wrongs.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o le a Ou tuu atu ia te outou le mata fiafia ma le mata alofa mai ia te i latou, ina ia outou mapu i le filemu ma le saogalemu, a’o outou fai atu i tagata: Ia faia faamasinoga ma le faamasinotonu mo i matou e tusa ma le tulafono, ma toe totogi mai ia te i matou e tusa ma sese na faia ia te i matou.

verses.en: Now, behold, I say unto you, my friends, in this way you may find favor in the eyes of the people, until the army of Israel becomes very great.
verses.sm: O lenei, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o a’u uo, o le ala lenei o le a mafai ona outou maua ai le mata fiafia mai o tagata, seia oo ina matua toatele le ’autau a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And I will soften the hearts of the people, as I did the heart of Pharaoh, from time to time, until my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., and mine elders, whom I have appointed, shall have time to gather up the strength of my house,
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou faamaluluina loto o tagata, e pei ona sa Ou faia i le loto o Farao, mai lea taimi i lea taimi, seia maua e la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma a’u toeaina, o e ua Ou tofia, se taimi e faapotopoto ai le malosi o lo’u fale,

verses.en: And to have sent wise men, to fulfil that which I have commanded concerning the purchasing of all the lands in Jackson county that can be purchased, and in the adjoining counties round about.
verses.sm: Ma auina atu ni alii atamamai, e faataunuu le mea na Ou poloaiina e faatatau i le faatauina mai o laueleele uma i le itumalo o Siakisone e mafai ona faatau mai, ma i itumalo sosoo ane faataamilo ai.

verses.en: For it is my will that these lands should be purchased; and after they are purchased that my saints should possess them according to the laws of consecration which I have given.
verses.sm: Aua o lo’u loto e tatau ona faatau mai ia laueleele; ma a uma ona faatau mai i latou e tatau ona maua i latou e la’u au paia e tusa ma tulafono o le faapaiaga ua Ou tuu atu.

verses.en: And after these lands are purchased, I will hold the armies of Israel guiltless in taking possession of their own lands, which they have previously purchased with their moneys, and of throwing down the towers of mine enemies that may be upon them, and scattering their watchmen, and avenging me of mine enemies unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me.
verses.sm: Ma a uma ona faatau mai o ia laueleele, o le a Ou lē ta’usalaina autau a Isaraelu i le ave o o latou lava laueleele, ia sa latou faatau muamua mai ia latou lava tupe, ma le lafoaiina i lalo o olo o o’u fili atonu o i ai i luga o i latou, ma le faataapeapeina o o latou leoleo, ma le tauimasui i o’u fili mo a’u e oo atu i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa o e inoino mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: But first let my army become very great, and let it be sanctified before me, that it may become fair as the sun, and clear as the moon, and that her banners may be terrible unto all nations;
verses.sm: Peitai ia muamua ona tuu atu i la’u autau ia matua faatoateleina, ma ia tuu atu ia faapaiaina i o’u luma, ina mafai ona lalelei e pei o le la, ma manino e pei o le masina, ma mafai ona mata’utia ona tagavai i atunuu uma;

verses.en: That the kingdoms of this world may be constrained to acknowledge that the kingdom of Zion is in very deed the kingdom of our God and his Christ; therefore, let us become subject unto her laws.
verses.sm: Ina ia uunaia malo o le lalolagi lenei e tautino mai o le malo o Siona o le malo moni lava lea o lo tatou Atua ma lana Keriso; o lea, ia tatou tuu atu i tatou e pulea i ana tulafono.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, it is expedient in me that the first elders of my church should receive their endowment from on high in my house, which I have commanded to be built unto my name in the land of Kirtland.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua tatau ia te a’u ona tatau ona maua e toeaina muamua o la’u ekalesia o latou faaeega mai lugā i lo’u fale, lea ua Ou poloaiina ia fausia i lo’u igoa i le laueleele o Katelani.

verses.en: And let those commandments which I have given concerning Zion and her law be executed and fulfilled, after her redemption.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu poloaiga ia na Ou tuuina atu e faatatau ia Siona ma lana tulafono ia faia ma faataunuuina, pe a mavae lona laveaiina.

verses.en: There has been a day of calling, but the time has come for a day of choosing; and let those be chosen that are worthy.
verses.sm: Sa i ai se aso o le valaaulia, ae ua oo mai le taimi mo se aso o le filifilia; ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou o e ua agavaa ia filifilia.

verses.en: And it shall be manifest unto my servant, by the voice of the Spirit, those that are chosen; and they shall be sanctified;
verses.sm: Ma o le a faaali atu i la’u auauna, i le leo o le Agaga, i latou ua filifilia; ma o le a faapaiaina i latou;

verses.en: And inasmuch as they follow the counsel which they receive, they shall have power after many days to accomplish all things pertaining to Zion.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo latou mulimuli i fautuaga latou te maua, o le a latou maua le mana pe a mavae aso e tele, e faataunuu ai mea uma e faatatau ia Siona.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, sue for peace, not only to the people that have smitten you, but also to all people;
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, aioi atu mo le filemu, ia lē na’o tagata o e na latou fasia outou, ae o tagata uma foi;

verses.en: And lift up an ensign of peace, and make a proclamation of peace unto the ends of the earth;
verses.sm: Ma ia siitia a’e i luga se tagavai o le filemu, ma fai se folafolaga o le filemu i tulu’iga o le lalolagi;

verses.en: And make proposals for peace unto those who have smitten you, according to the voice of the Spirit which is in you, and all things shall work together for your good.
verses.sm: Ma fai atu ni manatu faatu mo le filemu ia te i latou o e na fasia outou, e tusa ma le siufofoga o le Agaga ua i totonu o outou, ma o le a galulue faatasi mea uma mo lo outou lelei.

verses.en: Therefore, be faithful; and behold, and lo, I am with you even unto the end. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: O lea, ia faamaoni; ma faauta, ma tagai, ua Ou faatasi ma outou e oo lava i le iuga. E faapea lava. Amene.
